## Statement of work (as received)
STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) Senior Enablement Program Lead – NVIDIA AI Factory Readiness (Contract) 

**Position Summary**
 a global hardware manufacturer's services group is accelerating its NVIDIA AI Factory delivery capabilities and requires a Senior Enablement Program Lead to design, operationalize and execute a global technical enablement framework that prepares the manufacturer engineering teams to independently deploy, optimize and support NVIDIA AI Factory solutions. The Program Lead owns end-to-end enablement strategy across technical learning paths, instructor-led training, certification management, deployment shadowing, learning platform integration, operational reporting and executive governance. Working across NVIDIA, the manufacturer Delivery, Sales, Learning & Development, Manufacturing and Product organizations, this role establishes a scalable global enablement framework spanning AI infrastructure, software, networking, validation and operational services. 

**Scope of Services**
 The contractor will lead three strategic workstreams: (1) Global AI Factory Technical Readiness, (2) Learning Platform Integration, and (3) Global Enablement Operations. 

**Workstream 1**
 – Global AI Factory Technical Readiness Own and operationalize the manufacturer's complete NVIDIA AI Factory technical readiness program supporting approximately 80–100 global delivery engineers. AI Factory Infrastructure Deployment • GPU compute infrastructure deployment • NVIDIA networking deployment • AI infrastructure validation and performance optimization • Cluster deployment methodologies • Production readiness validation NVIDIA AI Enterprise (NVAIE) Software Enablement Foundation • AI Enterprise architecture and portfolio awareness • Software deployment concepts • Operational workflows Level 1 Support • Incident triage • Initial troubleshooting • Case routing • Operational support Level 2 Support • Advanced troubleshooting • Software configuration • Deployment optimization • Root cause analysis Product Specialization Develop advanced product-specific competency across Design, Configure, Build, Deploy, Operate and Manage disciplines for selected NVIDIA AI Enterprise solutions. Certification & Technical Validation Coordinate learning prerequisites, labs, exam readiness, certification completion, skills tracking and executive reporting. Field Readiness & Deployment Shadowing Phase 1 – Deployment Observation Phase 2 – Supervised Delivery Phase 3 – Independent Delivery Readiness 

**Workstream 2**
 – Learning Platform Integration Partner with the manufacturer Learning & Development to integrate NVIDIA learning paths into the manufacturer learning platforms, standardize learning journeys, maintain curriculum alignment, improve learner reporting and establish scalable enablement processes. 

**Workstream 3**
 – Global Enablement Operations Coordinate global technical workshops, training voucher utilization, manufacturing site enablement, deployment shadowing with NVIDIA NVIS teams, KPI reporting, executive reviews and continuous program improvement. 

**Learning Modalities**
 • Self-paced digital learning • Instructor-led NVIDIA training • the manufacturer-developed enablement content • Hands-on technical laboratories • Certification exams • Deployment shadowing • On-the-job learning • the manufacturer Grow integration • Role-based learning journeys 

**Technical Personas Supported**
 • Solution Architects • Pre-Sales Engineers • AI Factory Deployment Engineers • Infrastructure Delivery Engineers • Technical Services • L1/L2 Support Engineers • Manufacturing Technical Teams • Partner Delivery Organizations 

**Success Measures**
 • 80–100 engineers trained and deployment-ready • NVIDIA learning integrated into the manufacturer learning platforms • Global workshops executed across regions • Training vouchers and certifications successfully managed • Deployment shadowing program operational • Executive KPI reporting established 

**Contract Boundaries**
 In scope: global enablement strategy, program leadership, stakeholder coordination, reporting and operational execution. Out of scope: authoring NVIDIA curriculum, acting as instructor, software development, customer consulting delivery and commercial negotiations.
